evidence.description: The public shared instance exposes mutable statistics properties without an isolation or synchronization boundary.
fetchAndUpdate writes the mutable instance properties without synchronization.

candidates.explanation: Statistics exposes mutable instance state through its public static shared instance without actor isolation or synchronization. fetchAndUpdate mutates that shared state after fetching and decoding data, with no visible protection for these accesses.
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation
